title: [clinic · EX-01] Attribute ten failures
body:
> **Exercise clinic.** One long-running thread per exercise. Ask here rather than opening a
> new thread — the answers accumulate where the next person will look for them.
>
> **Exercise:** [`EX-01` — Attribute ten failures](https://github.com/akash-coded/nanorag/blob/main/docs/30-learning/exercises/ex-01-attribute-ten-failures.md) · difficulty 🟢

## What this exercise asks

Read the exercise first; this thread is for when you are stuck, not instead of it.

## Three ways people get stuck on this one

**1.** Bucketing by *symptom* ("answer was vague") instead of by **stage**. Vague answers come from all four verdicts and the bucket tells you nothing.

**2.** Attributing from the answer alone. Without checking whether gold reached the pool, and then the packed context, you cannot separate a retrieval miss from a packing loss.

**3.** Stopping at ten when nine of them are the same failure. Ten *distinct* attributions is the point; if the first ten are one bug, fix it and draw ten more.

## How to ask here

Post the **numbers you got**, the **config that produced them**, and **what you already tried**.
A question with a measurement in it gets answered in one round trip; a question without one
takes three.

If you have finished it, post the write-up in **Show and Tell** with the
`[solution · EX-01]` prefix rather than here — this thread stays for people who are stuck.
